name: Image preview
summary: A full-screen image lightbox the host opens with `open`, with an opt-in zoom, rotate and flip toolbar.
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-image-preview>, for showing an image full screen from any trigger: an eye button on an image's hover mask, a menu item, a thumbnail. It is the same overlay <aha-image> opens on click, as its own element with no frame, so the host owns `open`. Escape, a click on the mask or the close button emit a cancelable `close` (detail.source) and then remove `open`; `closed` fires once it is gone. `toolbar` adds a white bar of six icon buttons: zoom out, zoom in (1x to 5x in 0.5 steps, each disabled at its limit), rotate left, rotate right, flip horizontally, flip vertically. The view resets on every open and on a new `src`. While open it is a modal dialog: Tab is trapped, page scroll is locked and focus goes back to the opener.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render across frameworks. The toolbar is <aha-button variant="tertiary" icon-only> with system icons, and the view is one CSS transform on the image. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Mask
spec.value: fixed full screen, Overlay rgba(0,0,0,.4), 32px padding, fades over motion mid

spec.label: Image
spec.value: up to 90vw by 90vh, object-fit contain, radius lg 12; the panel scales .96 to 1 on open

spec.label: Close
spec.value: 20 by 20 white button, radius sm 6, system-x 16, 11px from the top and 15px from the right of the image

spec.label: Toolbar
spec.value: white bar 16px above the bottom edge, radius default 8, 4px padding and gap, six tertiary icon-only small buttons

spec.label: Zoom
spec.value: 1x to 5x in 0.5 steps; zoom out is disabled at 1x and zoom in at 5x

props.name: open
props.desc: shows the lightbox; the host owns it (or calls show() / close())

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: adds the zoom, rotate and flip bar

props.name: label · close-label · zoom-in-label · zoom-out-label · rotate-left-label · rotate-right-label · flip-horizontal-label · flip-vertical-label
props.desc: accessible names, for a translated host

props.name: close (event)
props.desc: cancelable; detail.source is escape, mask, close-button or method; cancel it to keep the lightbox open

whenToUse.when: a host opens an image full screen from its own trigger, or needs zoom, rotate or flip
a framed image that opens its own preview on click (use <aha-image preview>)

opinion.note: Keep `open` with the host and listen for `close`; never toggle the lightbox from inside the image. Turn the toolbar on only where people inspect the image itself (an uploaded image in an editor), not for a decorative picture.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe has a toolbar and stays closed; the shadow styles compute whether or not it is open.

selfCheck.label: controlled open, cancelable close then closed
overlay, panel and close match the aha-image preview

highlights: Opened by the host from any trigger
Opt-in zoom, rotate and flip toolbar
